outcome: Neonatal outcomes (gestation length, placental weight, neonatal weight, blood loss during delivery, and neonatal 5th-minute Apgar score)
finding: Independent of maternal age, advanced paternal age was associated with lower odds of spontaneous conceptions, higher odds of intracytoplasmic sperm injection, and lower odds of Cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Paternal age decreased the odds of any and urgent/emergent Cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Paternal age did not affect neonatal weight.
